env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 83: the argument of a go call in a group block is evaluated when the
# statement runs, whatever the option lowering turns it into. A coalesce
# over a map read or a const composite map read, a map read passed as an
# option, a value or nil passed as an option, an optional select and an
# optional call, alone or inside an operator expression or parentheses,
# eject to Go that parses and prints what the native run prints, for a
# plain call and for a function literal. The ejected module builds and
# runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^\[4 8 4 5 -1 3 3 5 11 4 1 13\]\n\[7 8 -1 5 -1 9 10 1 11 6 1 13\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/groupgooptionarg

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

type pt struct{ X int }

type box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, N: 2}

func (p *pt) Get() int { return p.X }

func rec(out []int, i, v int) { out[i] = v }

func opt(out []int, i int, v int?) { out[i] = v ?? -1 }

func run(ctx context.Context, m map[string]int, p *pt?, out []int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go rec(out, 0, m["a"] ?? 7)
		go func(v int) { out[1] = v }(m["b"] ?? 8)
		go opt(out, 2, m["a"])
		go opt(out, 3, 5)
		go opt(out, 4, nil)
		go rec(out, 5, p?.X ?? 9)
		go rec(out, 6, p?.Get() ?? 10)
		go rec(out, 7, (m["a"] ?? 0) + 1)
		go rec(out, 8, (m["zz"] ?? 11))
		go func(v int) { out[9] = v }(m["a"] ?? 1 + 5)
		go rec(out, 10, cfg.M["a"] ?? 12)
		go func(v int) { out[11] = v }(cfg.M["zz"] ?? 13)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	out := make([]int, 12)
	if err := run(context.Background(), map[string]int{"a": 4}, &pt{X: 3}, out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(out)
	out = make([]int, 12)
	var none *pt?
	if err := run(context.Background(), map[string]int{}, none, out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(out)
}
